parsed.summary: Lot LOT-0130 containing infotainment chips from Kestrel Electronics at Wacky Wheels Jackson, built from 2027-02-25 to 2027-03-01, was placed on hold. A total of 110 unsold vehicles were stopped from sale at 37 dealers and 150 owners of sold vehicles were contacted.
parsed.decision_reason: The control tower acted because this was a real incident matching quality_hold rules. All identifiers and dates were resolved against the data, the rehearsal on the digital twin passed with zero failures, and the live schedule baseline matched before the first write.
